title: Beekeeping Hive Inspection App Development Board
originalRequest: Design and build a mobile application for beekeepers to manage hive inspections, offline logging, and diagnostic metrics.
latestMessage: Design and build a mobile application for beekeepers to manage hive inspections, offline logging, and diagnostic metrics.

steps.title: Database Schema Design for Hive Inspections
steps.instruction: Create a local relational database schema to store hive records, including fields for queen status, brood pattern, pest levels, and temperament.
steps.acceptance: SQL schema file successfully compiled and integrated with SQLite entity-relationship wrappers.
steps.result: Database schema completed in first pass. Implemented tables for hives, apiaries, and inspection logs. Local testing confirms all SQLite foreign key relationships and indices resolve correctly.

steps.title: Implement Bidirectional Offline Sync Protocol
steps.instruction: Develop a background sync queue that buffers inspection logs when offline and reconciles updates with the remote server when a connection is restored.
steps.acceptance: System handles network dropouts gracefully and reconciles conflicting updates using a last-write-wins timestamp policy.
steps.result: Currently coding the conflicts reconciliation handler. Network loss interception works, and logs are buffered in local storage. Resolving an issue with concurrent batch updates.

steps.title: Hands-Free Voice-to-Text Inspection Notes
steps.instruction: Integrate a local speech-to-text library to allow beekeepers to log inspection observations hands-free while wearing heavy gloves.
steps.acceptance: High-accuracy transcription of key phrases when processed locally offline.
steps.result: Second attempt blocked. The offline models evaluated require too much memory for target lower-spec mobile devices, causing app crashes during transcription. Awaiting decision on whether to use a lightweight cloud API fallback or drop offline speech requirement.

steps.title: Bluetooth Smart Scale API Integration
steps.instruction: Build driver interfaces to fetch real-time hive weight measurements from commercial Bluetooth-enabled scale hardware.
steps.acceptance: Continuous weight data read from mock scale via BLE connection and plotted in the telemetry panel.
steps.result: Blocked after second attempt. The target scale SDK lacks support for the latest OS versions, resulting in persistent connection dropouts. Contacted vendor for an updated library; progress halted until they respond.

steps.title: Computer Vision Varroa Mite Count Classifier
steps.instruction: Train and deploy a lightweight TensorFlow model within the app to detect and count Varroa mites from camera close-ups of sticky boards.
steps.acceptance: Model successfully processes sample images and returns a count within a 15% margin of manual tallies.
steps.result: Blocked on second attempt due to low-resolution test datasets causing high false-positive rates. Need the field team to supply higher-resolution, annotated macro images of infested boards before retrying model calibration.

steps.title: Inspection Schedule Reminders
steps.instruction: Create local OS notification alerts to remind users when a hive inspection is due based on custom intervals.
steps.acceptance: Local push notifications triggered accurately based on date settings in user preferences.

steps.title: Export PDF Inspection Sheets
steps.instruction: Build a report engine to compile historical inspection data into a formatted PDF document suitable for printing or sharing.
steps.acceptance: Generated PDFs accurately render tables, notes, and visual health status charts.

steps.title: Automated Weather API Integration
steps.instruction: Query localized meteorological data during an inspection to automatically record ambient temperature, wind speed, and barometric pressure.
steps.acceptance: Current weather attributes are auto-populated based on the user's GPS coordinates upon creating an inspection log.

steps.title: Geospatial Apiary Mapping View
steps.instruction: Render a map displaying all registered apiaries, color-coded by current alert status or pending inspections.
steps.acceptance: Map correctly displays custom markers and groups hives cluster-style when zoomed out.

steps.title: Predictive Honey Yield Algorithm
steps.instruction: Analyze historical hive weight changes and seasonal weather records to forecast prospective honey harvest times and estimated yield.
steps.acceptance: Yield prediction engine outputs a statistical range with standard error margins based on historic input vectors.

steps.title: CSV Import/Export Pipeline
steps.instruction: Implement a backup utility allowing users to import legacy spreadsheet data or export full tables to standard CSV format.
steps.acceptance: Parsed CSV data merges flawlessly with the existing database without creating duplicate hive entities.
